subject: Verify TZ base branch and commit
command: git ls-remote --heads origin; git rev-parse feature/agod-instrumented-nes
finding: feature/agod-instrumented-nes resolves to 775aa68053c7b99bf699f16c1418b997ce507250, matching the TZ exactly; worktree clean
limitations: none

subject: AGOD standalone host checks
finding: all five AGOD checks pass at the base commit
limitations: host only; no Android, no blind ROM corpus

subject: Full project regression
finding: 115 PASS assertions, then stops at line 124 (fdb_game_check.cjs) because app/src/main/assets/lab/snes/core.js is absent
limitations: emscripten absent so SNES/GB retro cores cannot be built; 3 of 108 steps unrunnable here

subject: Steps after the blocker, run manually
finding: all 10 remaining non-retro steps pass
limitations: run outside check.sh with a cached org.json jar

subject: Reproduce TZ 2.1 AGOD coverage claims
finding: counter structural 7/7 and counter exact-typed 1/7 reproduce the TZ exactly; additionally lives exact-typed 7/7, fullTypeIdentified 0/7, verified rewards 0, independent confirmations 0, polarity unknown on all 7
limitations: synthetic controlled ROMs from the project's own generator, not blind commercial ROMs

subject: Reproduce TZ 2.2 trace claims and overhead
finding: parity counts reproduce exactly (32 ordered writes, 25 writer sites, 117 boundaries); host overhead does NOT reproduce stably: active p50 ratio 1.526 standalone vs 1.394 inside check.sh, detached 1.525 vs 1.285
limitations: 4-vCPU shared container; single runs, no repetition statistics

subject: Verify the four external SHAs named in the TZ
finding: all four SHAs exist in the named repositories
limitations: existence only; contents verified separately

subject: Resolve the real paths of the named mechanisms
finding: 2 of 4 paths implied by the TZ do not exist at the pinned SHA: rcheevos is src/runtime/rc_*.c (not src/rcheevos/*.c) and stable-retro is stable_retro/retro_env.py (package renamed). OCAtari's function lives in scripts/find_causative_ram_full.py. SB3 paths matched.
limitations: none

subject: License review of the four projects
command: fetch LICENSE at each pinned SHA
finding: all four are MIT; no incompatibility with GU (MIT); no code copied so no attribution obligation incurred yet
limitations: SPDX read from LICENSE text, no legal review

subject: Read SB3 DQN.train against the TZ's Double DQN requirement
finding: SB3's DQN.train at this SHA is VANILLA DQN: the TD target takes max over the target network, and the token 'double' does not occur in the file. NN-01 requires Double DQN, so that target must be written by GU and cannot be described as a port.
limitations: only dqn.py and buffers.py were read

subject: Read the reward source of Stable-Retro
finding: compute_step only delegates; reward and done come from a hand-written per-game scenario manifest (reward.variables/time/script, done.variables). This is per-ROM manual annotation, which 1.3 forbids as a product mechanism, but 11.2 permits for an independent oracle.
limitations: C++ read partially (loadReward/done paths)

subject: Read OCAtari find_causative_ram
finding: It is a RAM-write intervention probe: fixed-seed reset, ale.setRAM(i,v), one step, count changed pixel blocks vs baseline, keep addresses with 2..59 changed blocks. It intervenes on RAM, not on actions as AGOD-05 requires, needs arbitrary core RAM writes, carries a hardcoded game-specific setRAM(123,60), and establishes no goal or polarity.
limitations: upstream behaviour not reproduced; no differential test run

subject: Deterministic restore/replay precondition
command: scratch probe over jsnes toJSON/fromJSON on a controlled cartridge
finding: restore+replay is bit-identical for repeated neutral and repeated action arms, and the action arm differs from neutral; causal probing is therefore possible on this core
limitations: host only, one cartridge family

subject: Phase-shift confound in naive action-vs-neutral differencing
finding: Holding a button costs CPU time, the game loop misses a vblank and executes fewer iterations, so time-driven bytes are phase-shifted. reset held 12 frames produced exactly the neutral state at 11 frames (frameCounter 85, timer 5, noise 103). A naive difference would have claimed 101 false causal attributions of decoys across the 7 cartridges.
limitations: measured on the synthetic generator family

subject: Causal validation against the independent oracle
finding: 7/7 cartridges: score recovered from the positive button, lives from the negative button, menu from the menu button; all 8 buttons recovered via their own input-echo byte; 0 time-driven decoy attributions; 0 unwired buttons showing any effect beyond their own echo; 0 starts excluded as non-deterministic
limitations: synthetic controlled cartridges only, single-button masks held for the whole window, host only, no polarity/reward inferred, no blind corpus

subject: Resource depletion is observable without an oracle
finding: The negative button decrements lives 3->2->1->0, the value settles at a floor, and once depleted the positive button no longer changes the score. Loss of previously confirmed causal effects is the observable terminal signal.
limitations: one cartridge family

subject: Polarity induction and phase inference
finding: 7/7 cartridges: NEGATIVE polarity recovered for the correct button; 0/7 accumulators declared POSITIVE or promoted to VERIFIED (blocked by construction); PLAYING 7/7 and DEATH 7/7 recovered
limitations: synthetic cartridges; suppression is judged over a caller-supplied address scope because input echo never stops; separating input plumbing from game state generically is unsolved

subject: Verified reward broker and the UNKNOWN contract
finding: All 8 anti-reward-hacking cases of 6.3 behave as required plus 9 further cases (17 total). UNKNOWN packets carry no value key before or after a JSON round-trip. Intrinsic signals travel on a separate channel with no value key.
limitations: VERIFIED goals are supplied as fixtures: no registry exists yet to produce one, so G3 is advanced but not closed

subject: Evidence registry: a goal verified from its own disjoint holdout evidence
finding: 7/7 cartridges: the induced NEGATIVE goal reached VERIFIED from three independently run partitions (DISCOVERY/CALIBRATION/HOLDOUT, 2 starts each, 0 shared start keys) and the broker then paid out value -1. Negative controls on the same data: 0/7 accumulators verified, 0/7 verified when the holdout partition was rebuilt from discovery starts.
limitations: the three partitions come from one post-boot state at different neutral offsets (11/53/97): distinct parent states, but not independent play sessions; depletion is still driven by the checker using the oracle mask; TTL is a default, not a measurement

subject: Evidence registry: every shortcut to VERIFIED is refused
finding: 13/13 registry attacks refused by name: shared holdout start, renamed start (same parent state), restored-cache-only promotion, contradiction after verification, explicit contradiction, control episode as holdout, expired evidence, polarity not evidenced, polarity UNKNOWN, foreign profile revision, holdout without calibration, imported state from another ROM, no evidence at all.
limitations: in-memory persistence only; the start-key digest is stable, not cryptographic; no Layer Set format was touched

subject: Typed RAM field identification commits to one type
finding: 7/7 cartridges: the action-driven counter was typed correctly on its observed-active span, 6/7 also at its full declared width; lives typed exactly 7/7; counter encoding determined 7/7 and never claimed wrongly; signedness claimed 0 times (binary and two's complement have identical modular steps); lives encoding undetermined 0/7 by construction (every digit <=9 makes BCD and binary the same number). Baseline from logs/agod_rom_check.log: the exact typed counter spec was merely present in the candidate list on 1/7 and no type was ever selected (fullTypeIdentified is a constant false).
limitations: the only cartridge without full width is seed 7 (BCD, width 4, start 9): a carry into the upper bytes is unreachable in 150 events, so the low-order component is the honest answer; event sampling is supplied by the caller; role/polarity/meaning are not inferred; no visual HUD (AGOD-03); synthetic family only

subject: What the length-matched neutral control is worth
finding: Attributing simply 'bytes that changed while the action was pressed' makes the same identifier type 55 time-driven decoy fields as game variables across the 7 cartridges, typically one constant-step byte attributed to all eight buttons at once. With the neutral run of equal length and cadence as the control, that count is 0.
limitations: measured on the synthetic family; the control rules out time-driven bytes, not bytes driven by an action through a timer

subject: The learner is a learner: gradients, Double target, determinism, checkpoint
finding: Hand-written gradients match central finite differences to a maximum error of 5.4e-11 over every parameter. The Double DQN target differs from the vanilla one on a disagreement (-1.5197 vs -1.2109), and equals reward + gamma * target(s')[argmax online(s')] exactly. Identical seeds reproduce identical weights, different seeds do not. A checkpoint round-tripped through JSON continues to the same weights as an uninterrupted run (<1e-12), and a checkpoint of another shape is refused.
limitations: MSE loss (no clipping) so the finite-difference check has no kink to hide a wrong derivative; one hidden layer of 24 units; no hyperparameter search

subject: Behaviour changes only when the chain produced a VERIFIED reward
finding: 42 runs (7 cartridges x 6 agent seeds). The penalising button and the depleting resource were found without the oracle 42/42, and the goal reached VERIFIED through the registry on 7/7 cartridges. Frozen evaluation: penalised-action rate 0.000 trained, 0.508 untrained, 0.361 for a measured random policy; lives lost 0 vs 13.3 vs 15.3. Of the 4 of 6 agent seeds whose untrained policy chose the penalised action, 28/28 runs stopped choosing it, 0 got worse. Seed-independent form of the same result: Q(penalised) is the minimum of the three actions in 42/42 runs. The control performed 0 weight updates and received 0 payouts.
limitations: the untrained policy is cartridge-independent, so the control's effective sample size is 6 agent seeds and not 42 runs; three-action environment with scalar features, no pixels; the optimal policy is short; no published baseline was run; synthetic family only; Android untouched

subject: With only NEGATIVE reward available, only avoidance is learnable
finding: Among the two unpenalised actions - do nothing, or press the button that raises the counter - trained agents split 21/21. Nothing rewards scoring, because POSITIVE polarity is unprovable from inside the emulator (E4), so the agent is indifferent between scoring and standing still. It learned not to die and nothing else. UNKNOWN claims were never stored: 426-429 refusals per run went into no TD target, while 70-84 payouts did.
limitations: this is a property of the available reward, not of the learner; a positive objective needs the independent oracle of 11.2 or human labelling, neither of which exists

subject: The stages become one callable pipeline that can refuse
finding: agod-pipeline.js wires causal attribution, typing, induction, the registry and the broker into one call that returns either a VERIFIED goal or the stage and reason that refused. On the 7 development cartridges: 7/7 verified, cost action correct 7/7, depleting resource is the lives field 7/7, 0 refusals. The chosen increasing 'effect' field is the level counter rather than the score on 4/7, which is correct for its purpose (any persisting action-driven effect serves as the play-effect scope) and is why the metric was renamed effectMaskIsScoreButton and made informational.
limitations: the pipeline is expensive per cartridge (8 causal probes, a neutral run, typing per mask, three partitions with depletion); never run on Android; nothing in production imports it

subject: First run on cartridges never used in development
finding: Held-out rule fixed before the first run: the seven consecutive seeds 200..206, never used to develop or tune any stage, spanning all three score encodings, widths 1-4 and both byte orders. Result with no tuning and no per-cartridge parameter: 7/7 verified, cost action correct 7/7, resource is the lives field 7/7, 0 refusals. Agents trained only on the reward this pipeline verified: frozen cost-action rate 0.000, 0 lives lost, Q(cost) the minimum of the three actions in 21/21 runs, 1561 payouts and 0 runs without weight updates.
limitations: the held-out seeds come from the same generator, so this is not the blind corpus of 11.1 and there is no independent oracle (11.2); the agent's environment dynamics are cartridge-independent, so its effective sample size is 3 agent seeds, not 21 runs

subject: A perfect-looking zero that meant nothing, caught by an assertion
finding: The first attempt reported frozenCostRate 0.000 with 0 payouts and 0 weight updates on all 21 runs. The pipeline's last act is depleting the resource, so it hands back a dead machine and the agent arm started with the resource already at 0: every claim had zero magnitude, nothing was learnable, and the apparent avoidance was an untrained argmax in a frozen world. The assertion runsWithoutWeightUpdates === 0 caught it. Fixed by restoring the snapshot taken before the pipeline ran, plus a per-run assertion paidClaims > 0 so a vacuous zero cannot pass again.
limitations: the pipeline's own numbers are unaffected: the defect was in the arm that runs after the pipeline has committed its answer

subject: Experimental contour reachable from the lab behind a flag that costs nothing when off
finding: agod-experimental.js loads the seven stages on demand, so index.html gains one inert script rather than eight. Serving the production page twice, with and without that tag, gives identical page error sets (0 and 0), identical production entry points (5 and 5), zero research globals in both, and an identical research panel (14 children). Enabling the flag registers 7/7 stages and session(null) returns the pipeline's own named refusal, so it is genuinely wired. Four of five fixture-free UI checks pass; action_hold_ui_check fails identically with the bridge tag stripped out, because it iterates snes and gb cores that cannot be built without emscripten.
limitations: no user-facing toggle (the research panel is asserted on by existing UI checks); no interruptibility, no intermediate research state, no separate performance budget for active discovery; never run on Android

subject: Reward-certainty labels: UNKNOWN never becomes a zero
finding: 9 contract checks. An UNKNOWN step carries no value key before or after JSON and is never trainable; KNOWN_ZERO is a measured zero, is trainable and stops the credit walk-back so returns are not double counted; an UNKNOWN step offered a value is rejected at the door. Credit stops at the horizon, at an episode edge, at a restore boundary and at an evidenced reward, and a contradicted event reverts its credited steps to UNKNOWN without leaving a stale number. Eviction drops whole episodes rather than half a sequence.
limitations: KNOWN_ZERO is implemented but nothing in the contour produces it yet; intermediate credit events are implemented but only terminal ones are measured; the credit horizon of 64 is a parameter, not a measurement

subject: A decision 12 steps before the only confirmed outcome
finding: Same episodes, same seeds, same learner code; only the replay differs. Dropping UNKNOWN transitions leaves 300 trainable steps per run against 4200 with deferred credit. The expensive gate is chosen at rate 0.375 when dropping and 0.000 with credit, but the honest statement is the Q ordering at the decision point: the expensive action has the lowest Q in 8/8 seeds with deferred credit against 2/8 when dropping, and 2/8 is what chance gives for three actions. So the delayed decision is uninformed under the E5 scheme and learned on every seed under the corrected one.
limitations: synthetic chain built to isolate delay, not a game; credit also reaches corridor actions that have no effect, which is harmless here but would bias an environment where they differ; effective sample size is 8 agent initialisations, paired by seed; not yet wired to the emulator or the E6 pipeline

subject: A second independent family: the resource must be spent to progress
finding: The sacrifice family keeps the observable form E4 reads as harm (monotone decrease, a floor, confirmed effects ceasing there) while inverting its meaning: spending a charge raises progress, progress scales the gain of the act button (+1/+2/+3), the floor is completion rather than death, and restarting refills the charges while keeping the treasure. Buttons come from index sets disjoint from the first family and addresses are allocated downwards, so no learned button or layout carries over. Dynamics verified directly on the cartridge across seeds.
limitations: written by the same author as the first family, so the independence is in game logic, layout and buttons, not provenance; a third generator from someone else is still needed for 11.1

subject: The old rule mislabels a required action; the split refuses instead
finding: The depletion fact is observable on 7/7 sacrifice cartridges and the old E4 rule calls it NEGATIVE on 7/7, where the closed oracle label says it is not a cost (0/7 say it is). The split refuses at the new judge stage on 7/7, naming the discriminator ('the same action also raises 2 persisting fields: a cost that buys something is not evidence of harm'), while still verifying a real cost on 7/7 survival cartridges, so it is not merely refusing everything. E4's own numbers are bit-identical after the change: same totals, same 7 induction rows, same 17 negative cases.
limitations: the discriminators are not universal: a sacrifice whose benefit is not a rising field (an opened door, a cleared flag, a mode change) is invisible to both; NEGATIVE_GAME_REWARD still means 'not refuted by either observable sign', not proven harm

subject: What believing the mislabel costs in behaviour
finding: An agent trained on the mislabelled NEGATIVE reward learns not to spend at all (0 spends) and collects 50 treasure in 60 steps, against 174 for partial sacrifice (spend down to one charge, then act), 15 for a cycling policy and 0 for spending everything. The shortfall from believing the mislabel is 124 of 174 achievable, 71 percent. The cartridge's optimum is partial sacrifice: spending the last charge closes the gate and stops earning entirely.
limitations: the mislabelled reward is injected by the checker deliberately, so this models the consequence rather than the pipeline's behaviour; environment dynamics are cartridge-independent so the effective sample size is 3 agent seeds, not 9 runs

subject: A discriminator that read a death as a sacrifice, caught by its own check
finding: The first version of the reversible-floor discriminator watched a single increasing field. The pipeline's increasing field is often the level counter rather than the score, and a reset restores lives and zeroes the score while leaving the level standing - so the test read a death as a sacrifice and refused on survival 7/7. Fixed in substance: 'the gain survives the reversal' now means everything the suppressed play accumulated (every increasing field of a non-cost mask), not one arbitrary field. A second defect in the same run: the checker filtered the play scope by the neutral run only, which keeps the input echo - exactly the E4 mistake - now fixed to the intersection of moves-under-action and does-not-move-under-neutral.
limitations: found because the check asserted the split must still verify the survival family; without that assertion a one-sided discriminator would have looked like a success

subject: E6/E7 regression after the judge stage was added
finding: The pipeline gained a stage, so the whole E6/E7 check was re-run and compared against the committed artefact rather than merely passing: totals identical, all 14 per-cartridge verdicts identical, all 21 agent runs identical. Development 7/7 and held-out 7/7 still verify, cost mask and resource still correct 7/7, agent frozen cost rate still 0.000 with Q(cost) lowest in 21/21. The new judge stage refuses only where it should.
limitations: same generator family as before for both groups; the held-out rule (seeds 200..206) was not changed

subject: Three reward mechanisms kept apart
finding: VerifiedExtrinsicReward (claim), ProvisionalGoal (provisionalSignal) and IntrinsicExploration (intrinsicSignal) are named channels and exactly one carries a value key. A provisional signal has no value key before or after JSON; a provisional goal offered to the broker returns UNKNOWN with no value. agod-reward.js changed, so E4 was re-run: totals, all 17 negative cases and the UNKNOWN contract are identical to the committed artefact.
limitations: the separation is structural; nothing prevents a caller from adding provisionalValue to a reward by hand

subject: Automatic POSITIVE hypotheses, scored against closed labels
finding: The rule is fixed in the module before measurement and is not a tuned quorum. Over 63 increasing-field candidates found without the oracle: 7 proposed, precision 1.000, recall 1.000, abstention 0.889. On the survival family, where the closed label says no field is demonstrably beneficial, 0 of 28 candidates were proposed. On the sacrifice family treasure was proposed on 7/7 cartridges and nothing else was. No proposal carried a value key and none was ever VERIFIED. ROM bytes and every published SHA256 are unchanged by the oracle label addition, verified by regeneration.
limitations: 7 labelled beneficial candidates and 7 proposals: an indicator, not an estimate; the three rule factors were chosen knowing these two families

subject: One factor does the work and two are useless
finding: Per-factor truth on labelled-beneficial versus other candidates: monotoneNotTimeDriven is true for all 63 candidates and discriminates nothing; reachesStatesNeutralPlayDoesNot is true everywhere and is useless; changesAvailableActions is inconsistent (3/28 on one family, 28/28 on the other); survivesResourceReversal works only on the sacrifice family (21/28 non-beneficial candidates on survival also pass it); gainRateModulated separates perfectly on its own, 7/7 against 0/56. So the precision of 1.000 rests on one factor, not five, and calling this a multi-factor check would overstate it.
limitations: a game whose gain rate never changes would be missed entirely, and a decoy with a modulated rate would be a false positive; neither case exists in families I wrote myself
